title: The Circumference of a Radius-7 Circle
description: What pi actually means, applied to a circle with radius 7.
narration_lines: What's the circumference of a circle with radius 7?
Picture the radius wrapping around the circle's edge.
It takes about two times pi, around 6.28, of those radius-lengths to go all the way around.
So the circumference is about 44 units -- pi is just how many radiuses wrap around, doubled.

params.hook: Circumference of a circle with radius 7?
params.footnote: pi (≈3.14) is just how many "radiuses" wrap around, doubled
